teaser: A line forms at a folding table, and you keep it straight without being asked. Later, alone, you tally who still owes a thank-you and who you still owe one to. Life path 9 carries a pull toward the whole room, toward strangers who need a hand; the ISTJ carries a pull toward the one task in front of it, done exactly right. In you the two don't cancel out. The wide care of the 9 gets a spine it rarely has elsewhere, and the steady hands of the ISTJ get pointed at something larger than the next form filed. What's particular here is a generosity that keeps its receipts.
